sonnet.problem: The card says "that name STICKS" and then offers the saying "On the mountain of the LORD it will be provided." Verse 14 says only that this saying is still said to this day. It does not say the place name The LORD Will Provide stuck. The card stretches the text and points out something the text doesn't state.
sonnet.rule: Don't stretch the text. Exaggerate only in his own jokes. / Noticing: What he points out must be true.
